logline: Still trapped after the thousand-year struggle, Gajendra remembers a prayer through divine grace and turns his mind to the Supreme Lord.

source.edition: Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam 8.3.1–29 original te/hi/en retelling; third-party modern translations not copied
source.verification_notes: S01 anchors exactly 8.3.1: Gajendra fixed his intelligence/mind and remembered a prayer learned in a previous life by divine grace. The previous king's name is intentionally withheld until later source-authored reveal, not denied. L002's exact quiet water sound is original staging. No Sanskrit phrase, Gajendra human lips, or early divine manifestation is authored. Actual prayers 8.3.2–29 belong to S02–S06. Checked 2026-11-22. S02: SB 8.3.2–4, simple narration of reverence to Supreme, source and witness of creation, protection. No unapproved Sanskrit mantra recording or a fabricated earlier physical deity vision. S03: SB 8.3.5–9: Lord beyond annihilation/darkness, hard even for sages to grasp, revered by compassionate sages, not bound by ordinary material birth. No new action or divine arrival. S04: SB 8.3.10–15 praises the witness in every heart, enlightenment, bhakti, divine forms, origin and source of liberation; the depicted glow is only an original non-personal visual metaphor. S05: SB 8.3.16–24 stresses transcendent knowledge, mercy to surrendered Gajendra, pure devotional service without bargaining and Lord as source. L004's emotional staging is marked original; no blame of family love.

core_preserved: Gajendra fixes mind and intelligence in his heart and remembers a mantra learned in a previous lifetime by the grace of the Lord (SB 8.3.1).
SB 8.3.2–4, simple narration of reverence to Supreme, source and witness of creation, protection. No unapproved Sanskrit mantra recording or a fabricated earlier physical deity vision.
SB 8.3.5–9: Lord beyond annihilation/darkness, hard even for sages to grasp, revered by compassionate sages, not bound by ordinary material birth. No new action or divine arrival.
SB 8.3.10–15 praises the witness in every heart, enlightenment, bhakti, divine forms, origin and source of liberation; the depicted glow is only an original non-personal visual metaphor.

SB 8.3.16–24 stresses transcendent knowledge, mercy to surrendered Gajendra, pure devotional service without bargaining and Lord as source. L004's emotional staging is marked original; no blame of family love.
changes: Episode 3 continues from E02's decision without duplicating a new bite, release or millennium montage.
Previous-life visual reveal is reserved for Episode 5 while honestly identifying the prayer's earlier-life origin here.
Subdued water sounds, close eye/trunk reaction and visual quiet are original screenplay staging, not scripture incidents.
The source's Sanskrit chant is NOT auto-created, substituted, or claimed recorded. Spoken lines are original child-friendly paraphrases under NARRATOR.
adaptation.fidelity_note: Direct meaning of SB 8.3.1 is retained, especially grace and remembered prayer. No copyrighted modern translation, invented elephant dialogue, new deity arrival or premature lotus offering.

characters.description: Only offscreen trilingual spoken owner in a retelling of Gajendra's inner prayer.
characters.voice_direction: Tender contemplative tone; native/rights/voice approval pending.

characters.description: Approved full-body decorated elephant, still physically caught, expressing remembrance through natural eye/trunk posture only.
characters.voice_direction: No human mouth-synced speaking or yet-authorized Gajendra voice ID.

characters.description: Approved olive stylized crocodile still holding the exact chosen left foreleg, no extra violent action.

scenes.title: Stillness amid the struggle
scenes.setting: Same lotus lake after the prolonged contest, waterline and the established crocodile left-foreleg grip unchanged.
scenes.action: Gajendra steadies his mind, and through divine grace a prayer learned in a previous life comes back. The narrator carries the spiritual meaning; visuals show natural quiet body posture without lipsync or premature revelation.
nonverbal_beats: Start exactly after E02/S06 with Gajendra still caught; no second new bite or immediate release.
Use approved Gajendra and crocodile identities exactly; no photo-real animal textures, no facial identity shifts, no mouth words.
A quiet focus on Gajendra's eyes/trunk represents remembering; this is cinematic staging not an audible verse.
Earlier-life knowledge is stated as scripture but the flashback king's identity is not visually shown until E05.
No 8.3.30–33 divine arrival; scene ends on remembered prayer before it is expressed in S02.

shots.camera: 16:9 natural elephant full-body silhouette and medium look with unchanged left-foreleg crocodile hold; no mouth-sync, no new attack.
shots.sound: Only narrator speech as future audio owner; restrained lake/water effects and quiet are PLANNED.

scenes.title: A remembered prayer begins
scenes.setting: The same freshwater lotus lake and Gajendra's unchanged crocodile grip, with the prior-life prayer now expressed through original narrator paraphrase, not an unauthorized Sanskrit chanting track.
scenes.action: Gajendra's inner prayer venerates the Supreme Person as the source, foundation and witness of life and creation, seeking protection. SB 8.3.2–4. No human animal lip-sync or early arrival of Lord Nārāyaṇa.
nonverbal_beats: Continue from the divinely remembered prayer in S01; the script is a simple modern Telugu/Hindi/English prose paraphrase, not a copied published translation or literal Sanskrit chant.
Gajendra's lips stay naturally elephant-like and still; prayer thoughts are carried by NARRATOR audio owner.
Cosmic light/water reflections can symbolically suggest origin and consciousness as original cinematography, not an early physical appearance of Nārāyaṇa.
Do not place a lotus in Gajendra's trunk as an offering before the Lord arrives in E04 (SB 8.3.32).
Preserve approved Gajendra/crocodile identity and the same left-foreleg grip throughout.

scenes.title: The Lord beyond fear and time
scenes.setting: Quiet inward prayer over the same trapped lake situation. Nature light and distance offer humble metaphors of the Lord beyond material creation; no new event is claimed in the ancient account.
scenes.action: Paraphrase the Lord's transcendence beyond darkness, understanding and ordinary material birth, and the reverent devotion of compassionate sages (SB 8.3.5–9), without turning theological metaphors into literal creatures or scenes.
nonverbal_beats: Use a visually distinct but subtle gentle-light metaphor for divine transcendence, not a fabricated physical audience with Narayana before E04.
Cinematic visual symbols are declared original; the words remain independent paraphrases tied to exact verses.
Sages discussed are conceptual and do not enter the lake as newly named characters or speakers.
Keep the Gajendra identity, zoological anatomy, left foreleg and crocodile hold stable; no automatic elephant mouth prayer synchronization.
End with recognition of a Supreme Lord greater than ordinary birth, not with an early rescue or lotus offering.

scenes.title: The Lord present in every heart
scenes.setting: The same lake with Gajendra trapped, while narrator retells his inward reverence for the divine witness and light of every heart. The visual metaphors do not represent physical deity arrival.
scenes.action: Paraphrase SB 8.3.10–15 about the Supreme witness in the heart, source of knowledge, genuine devotional relationship, and cause beyond causes; the Lord does not yet appear on Garuda.
nonverbal_beats: Keep Gajendra and crocodile in approved storybook full-body identities and unchanged grip; no talking animal lips.
Use gentle reflection/lighting metaphor to explain the divine witness in hearts; abstract light is original cinematography, not a literal character entering the lake.
Do not introduce narrated quotations from modern published translations or unreviewed Sanskrit chant.
Mention divine forms reverently in narrator words, but do not visualize an unapproved extra incarnation on screen.
End on sincere inward remembrance and devotion; Narayana's visible arrival is reserved for E04.

scenes.title: Devotion beyond bargaining
scenes.setting: Same lotus lake, elephant still caught, no physical rescue. Gajendra's attention remains on the Supreme through narrator paraphrase.
scenes.action: Condense SB 8.3.16–24 to a child-accessible prayer that stresses the Lord's closeness, mercy for surrendered beings, bhakti without bargaining, and the Lord as source of all creatures.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Though still caught, Gajendra steadied his mind.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడు ఇంకా మొసలి పట్టులోనే ఉన్నా, తన మనసును నిలిపాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र अब भी मगरमच्छ की पकड़ में था, फिर भी उसने अपना मन स्थिर किया।
text.en: Though still caught, Gajendra steadied his mind.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Amid the struggle, his attention turned inward.

text.te: పోరాట శబ్దాల మధ్య అతని ధ్యానం లోపలికి తిరిగింది.
text.hi: संघर्ष के बीच उसका ध्यान अपने भीतर गया।
text.en: Amid the struggle, his attention turned inward.

source_attribution.note: Original quiet visual staging: Gajendra's attention turning inward amid existing water sounds. SB 8.3.1 states he fixed his mind and remembered prayer, but does not prescribe this precise soundscape or camera.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: A prayer he had learned long ago returned to him.

text.te: ఎప్పుడో నేర్చుకున్న ఒక ప్రార్థన అతనికి గుర్తొచ్చింది.
text.hi: उसे बहुत पहले सीखी हुई एक प्रार्थना याद आने लगी।
text.en: A prayer he had learned long ago returned to him.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: It came from his devotion in an earlier life.

text.te: ఆ ప్రార్థన అతని గత జన్మలోని భక్తికి సంబంధించినది.
text.hi: वह प्रार्थना उसके पिछले जन्म की भक्ति से जुड़ी थी।
text.en: It came from his devotion in an earlier life.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: By the Lord's grace, the remembered prayer returned.

text.te: భగవంతుడి కృపతో ఆ మాటలు మళ్లీ అతని మనసులో మెదిలాయి.
text.hi: भगवान की कृपा से वे शब्द उसके मन में फिर जाग उठे।
text.en: By the Lord's grace, the remembered prayer returned.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra held his mind on that prayer.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడు ఆ ప్రార్థనపై తన మనసును నిలిపాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र ने अपना मन उसी प्रार्थना पर टिकाया।
text.en: Gajendra held his mind on that prayer.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: In his heart, Gajendra bowed to the Supreme Person.

text.te: మనసులో గజేంద్రుడు పరమాత్మకు నమస్కరించాడు.
text.hi: मन ही मन गजेन्द्र ने परम भगवान को प्रणाम किया।
text.en: In his heart, Gajendra bowed to the Supreme Person.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He remembered the Lord as the source of all life.

text.te: సమస్త జీవుల జీవానికి మూలం ఆయనే అని గుర్తుచేసుకున్నాడు.
text.hi: उसे याद आया कि वही सब जीवों के जीवन का मूल हैं।
text.en: He remembered the Lord as the source of all life.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He meditated on the Lord present in every heart.

text.te: ప్రతి హృదయంలో ఉండే పరమాత్మను ధ్యానించాడు.
text.hi: उसने सबके हृदय में रहने वाले परमात्मा का ध्यान किया।
text.en: He meditated on the Lord present in every heart.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The whole creation rests upon the Lord.

text.te: సృష్టి అంతటికీ ఆధారం ఆ భగవంతుడే.
text.hi: सारी सृष्टि का आधार वही भगवान हैं।
text.en: The whole creation rests upon the Lord.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He is also its first cause.

text.te: ఆ సృష్టికి మొదటి కారణం కూడా ఆయనే.
text.hi: उस सृष्टि का प्रथम कारण भी वही हैं।
text.en: He is also its first cause.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Yet the Lord remains beyond His creation.

text.te: అయినా ఆయన సృష్టికి అతీతంగా ఉంటాడు.
text.hi: फिर भी वे सृष्टि से परे रहते हैं।
text.en: Yet the Lord remains beyond His creation.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The power that reveals the world also comes from Him.

text.te: లోకం కనిపించేలా చేసే శక్తి కూడా ఆయనదే.
text.hi: संसार को प्रकट करने की शक्ति भी उन्हीं की है।
text.en: The power that reveals the world also comes from Him.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He remains the witness of all that happens.

text.te: జరిగే ప్రతిదానికీ ఆయన సాక్షిగా ఉంటాడు.
text.hi: वही हर घटना के साक्षी रहते हैं।
text.en: He remains the witness of all that happens.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra sought protection from that Supreme Lord.

text.te: ఆ సర్వోన్నతుడే తనను కాపాడాలని గజేంద్రుడు కోరుకున్నాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र ने उन्हीं सर्वोच्च भगवान से रक्षा की आशा की।
text.en: Gajendra sought protection from that Supreme Lord.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Even as worlds change, the Lord remains beyond them.

text.te: లోకాలు మారినా భగవంతుడు అన్నిటికీ అతీతుడు.
text.hi: संसार बदलता रहे, भगवान सबके परे रहते हैं।
text.en: Even as worlds change, the Lord remains beyond them.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Beyond even deep darkness, His light remains.

text.te: గాఢమైన చీకటికీ అతీతంగా ఆయన వెలుగు ఉంటుంది.
text.hi: गहरे अँधेरे से भी परे उनका प्रकाश रहता है।
text.en: Beyond even deep darkness, His light remains.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra longed for that refuge.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడు ఆ ఆశ్రయాన్నే కోరుకున్నాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र ने उसी शरण की इच्छा की।
text.en: Gajendra longed for that refuge.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Even great sages cannot describe all the Lord's glory.

text.te: ఎంత గొప్ప ఋషులైనా ఆయన మహిమ అంతా చెప్పలేరు.
text.hi: बड़े-बड़े ऋषि भी उनकी महिमा पूरी तरह नहीं कह सकते।
text.en: Even great sages cannot describe all the Lord's glory.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: His ways go beyond what we can fully understand.

text.te: ఆయన కార్యాలు మన ఆలోచనలకు అందనంత లోతైనవి.
text.hi: उनके कार्य हमारी समझ से बहुत गहरे हैं।
text.en: His ways go beyond what we can fully understand.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Still, Gajendra turned to Him with devotion.

text.te: అయినా గజేంద్రుడు భక్తితో ఆయననే ఆశ్రయించాడు.
text.hi: फिर भी गजेन्द्र ने भक्ति से उन्हीं की शरण ली।
text.en: Still, Gajendra turned to Him with devotion.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Sages who care for all beings seek the Lord's feet.

text.te: అందరితో దయగా మెలిగే ఋషులు ఆయన పాదాలను ఆశ్రయిస్తారు.
text.hi: सबके प्रति दया रखने वाले ऋषि उनके चरणों की शरण चाहते हैं।
text.en: Sages who care for all beings seek the Lord's feet.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The Lord's birth is not like birth in this world.

text.te: భగవంతుడి పుట్టుక మనలాంటి జీవుల పుట్టుక కాదు.
text.hi: भगवान का जन्म हमारे जैसा साधारण जन्म नहीं है।
text.en: The Lord's birth is not like birth in this world.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He can show compassion through many divine forms.

text.te: అనేక దివ్య రూపాల్లో ఆయన కరుణను చూపగలడు.
text.hi: वे अनेक दिव्य रूपों में अपनी करुणा दिखा सकते हैं।
text.en: He can show compassion through many divine forms.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The Supreme Lord is the witness in every heart.

text.te: ప్రతి జీవి హృదయంలో పరమాత్మ సాక్షిగా ఉంటాడు.
text.hi: परमात्मा हर जीव के हृदय में साक्षी बनकर रहते हैं।
text.en: The Supreme Lord is the witness in every heart.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: His wisdom brings light to the mind.

text.te: ఆయన జ్ఞానం మన మనసుకు వెలుగునిస్తుంది.
text.hi: उनका ज्ञान हमारे मन को प्रकाश देता है।
text.en: His wisdom brings light to the mind.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Words alone cannot fully describe Him.

text.te: మాటలతో మాత్రమే ఆయనను పూర్తిగా తెలుసుకోలేం.
text.hi: केवल शब्दों से हम उन्हें पूरी तरह नहीं समझ सकते।
text.en: Words alone cannot fully describe Him.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Sincere devotion draws us toward Him.

text.te: నిజమైన భక్తి మనల్ని ఆయనకు దగ్గర చేస్తుంది.
text.hi: सच्ची भक्ति हमें उनके निकट ले जाती है।
text.en: Sincere devotion draws us toward Him.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He shows compassion through many divine forms.

text.te: ఆయన ఎన్నో దివ్య రూపాల్లో కరుణను చూపుతాడు.
text.hi: वे कई दिव्य रूपों में अपनी करुणा प्रकट करते हैं।
text.en: He shows compassion through many divine forms.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He is the source of nature and living beings.

text.te: ప్రకృతికీ జీవులకీ మూలం ఆయనే.
text.hi: प्रकृति और जीवों का मूल भी वही हैं।
text.en: He is the source of nature and living beings.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He knows what happens within each of us.

text.te: మనలో జరిగే ప్రతిదీ ఆయనకు తెలుసు.
text.hi: हमारे भीतर होने वाली हर बात वे जानते हैं।
text.en: He knows what happens within each of us.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He can guide us when we are uncertain.

text.te: సందేహంలో ఉన్న మనకు దారి చూపగలడు.
text.hi: संदेह में पड़े लोगों को वे मार्ग दिखा सकते हैं।
text.en: He can guide us when we are uncertain.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He is the great refuge for knowledge and liberation.

text.te: జ్ఞానానికీ విముక్తికీ ఆయనే గొప్ప ఆశ్రయం.
text.hi: ज्ञान और मुक्ति के लिए वे ही महान आश्रय हैं।
text.en: He is the great refuge for knowledge and liberation.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The Lord knows what our senses cannot grasp.

text.te: మన ఇంద్రియాలకు అందని జ్ఞానం కూడా భగవంతుడికి తెలుసు.
text.hi: हमारी इंद्रियों से परे की बात भी भगवान जानते हैं।
text.en: The Lord knows what our senses cannot grasp.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Though unseen, the Lord is not far from the heart.

text.te: కంటికి కనిపించకపోయినా ఆయన హృదయానికి దూరం కాదు.
text.hi: आँखों से न दिखें, फिर भी वे हृदय से दूर नहीं हैं।
text.en: Though unseen, the Lord is not far from the heart.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: His mercy can protect Gajendra, who seeks refuge in danger.

text.te: కష్టంలో శరణు కోరిన గజేంద్రుడిని ఆయన కరుణ రక్షించగలదు.
text.hi: कष्ट में शरण माँगने वाले गजेन्द्र की रक्षा उनकी करुणा कर सकती है।
text.en: His mercy can protect Gajendra, who seeks refuge in danger.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra offered both his fear and hope with humility.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడు భయంతో పాటు తన ఆశనూ ఆయన ముందుంచాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र ने अपने भय के साथ अपनी आशा भी भगवान के सामने रखी।
text.en: Gajendra offered both his fear and hope with humility.

source_attribution.note: Original child-facing reflective phrasing of Gajendra's vulnerability and faith, based on the source's surrender theme; SB 8.3.16–19 does not specify a separate 'fear and hope placed before God' narrative action.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Devotees value the Lord's love above possessions.

text.te: భక్తులు సంపదలకంటే భగవంతుని ప్రేమనే ఎక్కువగా కోరుకుంటారు.
text.hi: भक्त धन से बढ़कर भगवान का प्रेम चाहते हैं।
text.en: Devotees value the Lord's love above possessions.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: They do not pray only to receive rewards.

text.te: వారు బహుమతుల కోసం మాత్రమే ప్రార్థించరు.
text.hi: वे केवल वरदान पाने के लिए प्रार्थना नहीं करते।
text.en: They do not pray only to receive rewards.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: They find joy in remembering and serving Him.

text.te: ఆయనను స్మరించడం, సేవ చేయడం వారికి ఆనందం.
text.hi: उनका स्मरण और सेवा करना ही उन्हें आनंद देता है।
text.en: They find joy in remembering and serving Him.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The Lord is the source of all living beings.

text.te: సమస్త జీవులకు ఆ పరమాత్మే మూలం.
text.hi: सभी जीवों का मूल वही परम भगवान हैं।
text.en: The Lord is the source of all living beings.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra sought true freedom, not merely escape from danger.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడు ప్రమాదం నుంచి తప్పించుకోవడానికే కాదు, నిజమైన విముక్తినీ కోరుకున్నాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र केवल खतरे से बचना नहीं, सच्ची मुक्ति भी चाहता था।
text.en: Gajendra sought true freedom, not merely escape from danger.
